freeTier.summary: The Agentic plan costs $0/mo but only puts your products in Shopify Catalog for AI chat channels and the Shop channel. You can build an online store on it but not publish it or take orders through its checkout, and Shopify Payments or third-party transaction fees apply to sales made through Shopify's direct checkout. There is no free plan for running a public online store.

trial.summary: 3-day free trial with no credit card required. New stores then pay $1/month for the first 3 months on Basic, Grow or Advanced (monthly billing) before the standard monthly price applies.

plans.name: Agentic
plans.note: No subscription fee. Shopify's help centre describes it as a plan for merchants that don't already use Shopify as their ecommerce platform, for selling in AI chat channels through Shopify Catalog; you pay only payment fees when you make a sale.
limits: Online store stays password-protected; moving to a paid plan is required to publish it
Can't publish an online store or take orders through the online store checkout
No gift cards, manual orders, Shopify Messaging or Shop post-purchase offers
highlights: Online card rates from 2.9% + 30¢ with Shopify Payments
Also sells on the Shop channel
Store settings and products carry over when you move to a paid plan

plans.name: Basic
plans.note: For solo entrepreneurs. Store owner only: no staff accounts.
limits: 0 staff accounts (store owner only; collaborators and POS-only staff don't count)
highlights: Online card rate 2.9% + 30¢ with Shopify Payments
2% Shopify fee on orders taken through a third-party payment provider
Unlimited products, full online store and blog
In-person selling included; POS Pro is $89/mo per location extra

plans.name: Grow
plans.note: For small teams. Previously named the Shopify plan.
limits: Carrier-calculated shipping only with annual billing or for an extra monthly fee
highlights: Online card rate 2.7% + 30¢ with Shopify Payments
1% Shopify fee on orders taken through a third-party payment provider
Full data access for custom apps built on Shopify APIs

plans.name: Advanced
highlights: Online card rate 2.5% + 30¢ with Shopify Payments
0.6% Shopify fee on orders taken through a third-party payment provider
Third-party calculated shipping rates included
Enhanced 24/7 live chat support
Per-market store, checkout and customer account customization

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Requires a 1-year term at $2,500/mo or a 3-year term at $2,300/mo (the advertised starting price), per the Plus pricing FAQ. More complex, higher-volume businesses pay a variable platform fee based on revenue instead (quote from sales). The card rate, staff, POS Pro, expansion-store and B2B figures in highlights come from the main pricing page's comparison table (sources[0]), not the Plus FAQ.

highlights: Unlimited staff accounts (pricing page comparison table)
Online card rate 2.25% + 30¢ on the US pricing page
0.2% fee with a third-party payment provider; waived if Shopify Payments is the only provider
20 POS Pro locations included, up to 200 with Shopify Payments (pricing page comparison table)
Up to 9 free expansion stores and unlimited B2B catalogs (pricing page comparison table)
Full checkout customization and priority 24/7 support

billingNotes: Basic, Grow and Advanced cost $39, $105 and $399 a month month-to-month, or $29, $79 and $299 a month billed yearly. Yearly billing charges the full year upfront ($348, $948 and $3,588).

Shopify Plus has no month-to-month option: it starts at $2,500/mo on a 1-year term or $2,300/mo on a 3-year term, and more complex, higher-volume businesses pay a variable platform fee based on revenue. A Plus subscription can be cancelled when its term commitment expires.

New stores get a 3-day free trial with no credit card, then $1/month for the first 3 months on Basic, Grow or Advanced, after which the standard price applies. Switching to yearly billing during that promotion starts the annual cycle when the promotion ends, with the full year charged upfront.

Shopify Rewards (new merchants only): for the first 6 months, 1% back on sales through Shopify Payments (0.5% through other providers) as subscription credits, capped (in USD markets) at $5,000 on Basic, $7,500 on Grow, $10,000 on Advanced and, for Plus through self-serve enrollment, $10,000 or $15,000 (1- or 3-year contract). Credits are lost if you cancel. The scenarios leave these credits out.
No Shopify transaction fee applies to orders paid through Shopify Payments, Shop Pay, Shop Pay Installments, PayPal Express Checkout or manual methods such as cash on delivery and bank transfer.

For stores created on or after May 12, 2025, the part of an order paid with gift cards or store credit is charged the plan's third-party transaction fee even when the store uses Shopify Payments. Plus stores that use Shopify Payments as their only provider have these fees waived.

Staff accounts: Basic allows none (store owner only), Grow up to 5, Advanced up to 15, Plus unlimited. The store owner, collaborator accounts for freelancers and agencies, and POS-only staff don't count toward the limit.
Third-party carrier-calculated shipping is included on Advanced and Plus. Grow gets it only with yearly billing or for an extra monthly fee; Basic can't activate it.

Themes and apps are real, variable extra costs: paid themes are one-time purchases, and third-party apps charge their own subscriptions on their own billing cycle. Neither is included in the scenarios.

There are no setup fees. Plan charges are generally non-refundable. Downgrades, and switches from yearly to monthly billing, take effect at the end of the current billing cycle; the help centre says to contact Shopify Support before the yearly cycle ends to move to monthly billing.
The Starter and Retail plans are closed to new stores, and merchants who leave either plan can't switch back to it.
Shopify's own estimate for US stores using Shopify Payments: Grow's lower card rates pay for its higher price at about $200,000 a year in sales, and Advanced's at about $1,320,000 a year.
Grow is the plan previously named Shopify; the rename is noted in Shopify's developer changelog.

regional.note: Shopify adjusts subscription prices to the local cost of living in some regions and bills Basic, Grow and Advanced in EUR, GBP, INR or USD depending on where the store is located (new Plus merchants can also be billed in AUD, JPY or CAD). Card rates, Rewards caps and Shopify Payments availability vary by country. Figures here are the US list prices in USD.

scenarios.label: Solo store owner, $3,000/mo in sales
scenarios.assumptions: 1 person, the store owner, so Basic's lack of staff accounts doesn't matter. $3,000/mo of online sales paid through Shopify Payments, so Shopify adds no transaction fee; assumes no orders are paid with gift cards or store credit, which stores created on or after May 12, 2025 pay the third-party fee on. Card processing is not summed: at Basic's 2.9% + 30¢ online rate it is about $87 on $3,000 plus 30¢ per order. Themes and apps are excluded.

lines.label: Shopify transaction fee (none with Shopify Payments)

scenarios.note: Billed yearly, Basic is $29/mo ($348 upfront). With a third-party payment provider instead of Shopify Payments, Shopify adds 2% of sales: $60/mo on $3,000 (2% × $3,000).

scenarios.label: Small team, $30,000/mo in sales, 3 staff accounts
scenarios.assumptions: 5 people, 3 of whom need their own Shopify admin login. Basic allows no staff accounts, so Grow (up to 5) is the cheapest plan that fits. $30,000/mo of online sales through Shopify Payments, so no Shopify transaction fee; assumes no orders are paid with gift cards or store credit, which stores created on or after May 12, 2025 pay the third-party fee on. Card processing is not summed: at Grow's 2.7% + 30¢ online rate it is about $810 on $30,000 plus 30¢ per order. Themes and apps are excluded.

lines.label: Shopify transaction fee (none with Shopify Payments)

scenarios.note: Billed yearly, Grow is $79/mo ($948 upfront). With a third-party payment provider, Shopify adds 1% of sales: $300/mo on $30,000 (1% × $30,000).

scenarios.label: Growing store, $150,000/mo in sales, 8 staff accounts
scenarios.assumptions: 15 people, 8 of whom need their own Shopify admin login. Grow caps staff accounts at 5, so Advanced (up to 15) is required. $150,000/mo of online sales through Shopify Payments, so no Shopify transaction fee; assumes no orders are paid with gift cards or store credit, which stores created on or after May 12, 2025 pay the third-party fee on. Card processing is not summed: at Advanced's 2.5% + 30¢ online rate it is about $3,750 on $150,000 plus 30¢ per order. Themes and apps are excluded.

lines.label: Shopify transaction fee (none with Shopify Payments)

scenarios.note: Billed yearly, Advanced is $299/mo ($3,588 upfront). With a third-party payment provider, Shopify adds 0.6% of sales: $900/mo on $150,000 (0.6% × $150,000).

unverified: Starter plan price: Shopify's current pricing page no longer lists Starter, shopify.com/starter now redirects to the free-trial offer, and the help centre says Starter isn't available to new stores. No captured Shopify page shows its price, so it is not listed.
Retail plan price: the plan is closed to new stores and no captured Shopify page shows its price.
The monthly fee for adding carrier-calculated shipping to a Grow plan billed monthly is not published; the help centre only says it costs an additional monthly fee.
The Advanced tax platform is marked as an add-on on every plan, with no price on the pricing page.

Shopify Plus: the variable platform fee for complex businesses is quote-only, non-US card rates require contacting sales, and Shopify's pages differ on how the Plus term is paid (the pricing page's comparison table puts 'Starts at $2,300 USD/mo' in its Pay monthly row and marks Pay yearly as not included, while shopify.com/about shows $2,300 'billed yearly' on a 3-year term). We list the 1-year term price in the annual column because every Plus option carries at least a 1-year commitment. The terms behind the pricing page's 'Try for $399' Plus button were not captured.
The pricing page does not define which cards count as premium cards for the higher online rate.
Domain registration and paid theme prices vary and were not captured.
